entry.author: NZ Law Commission
entry.summary:
Law Commission publishes Terms of Reference in Hara Ngākau Kino | Hate Crime

We have published the Terms of Reference that will guide our review of the law relating to hate crime: He Arotake i ngā Hara Ngākau Kino.

Please visit our website: https://www.lawcom.govt.nz/our-work/hate-crime/terms-of-reference/ to access translated and accessible versions of the Terms of Reference and sign-up for updates.
